Calculate an action-aware score and its detail together

Source: R/Analyze_ActionRiskScore.R
Analyze_ActionRiskScore.Rd

Computes contributions once and summarizes the same rows into the adjusted score. Source retrieval and persistence remain outside this function.

Usage

Analyze_ActionRiskScore(
  dfResults,
  dfWeights,
  dfActionLog,
  dfExcludedSignals = NULL,
  bUseSnapshotDate = FALSE,
  intActionWindowDays = 90L,
  strActionPolicy = "disposition",
  bActionHistoryComplete = FALSE,
  dActionExtractionDate = NULL,
  dActionAsOfDate = NULL,
  strMetricID = "Analysis_srs0002",
  bScoreSnapshotNoAction = bUseSnapshotDate
)

Arguments

dfResults

Current persisted KRI result rows. Must contain one `StudyID` and one `SnapshotDate` plus `GroupLevel`, `GroupID`, `MetricID`, and `Flag`.

dfWeights

Risk score weights with `MetricID`, `Flag`, `Weight`, and `WeightMax`.

dfActionLog

ActionLog rows with the five-column result key, `State`, and `ExtractionDate`, for the same `StudyID` as `dfResults`. It may hold several entries per group and metric at different `SnapshotDate`s; for each group and metric the latest signal snapshot on or before `dActionSnapshotDate` is used within the selected frozen extraction. Multiple actions and signals at that snapshot are reduced using the largest configured factor. Identifiers must distinguish those rows.

dfExcludedSignals

Optional source quarantine audit. Known site/KRI records block that pair, missing metric IDs block the site, and unknown sites block the affected study. NULL means no records were quarantined.

bUseSnapshotDate

Use labelled work-item snapshot date proxies and recent, unambiguous No Action dispositions. Default FALSE. This does not manufacture verified decision coverage.

intActionWindowDays

Optional nonnegative integer. When supplied, use [MakeActionSummary()] to gate decisions by recency and applicability. The default policy calculates review priority; `"disposition"` applies the configured state factor only to eligible recent decisions. NULL preserves legacy state weighting.

strActionPolicy

Date-window policy. `"recent-review"` preserves the review-priority behavior: a recent applicable decision excludes its weight. The opt-in `"disposition"` draft applies `lActionFactors` only while that decision is recent and applicable. Defaults retain Open/Closed weights and exclude only a documented No Action decision. Expired/unknown evidence retains full weight. Neither policy changes the denominator or raw SRS.

bActionHistoryComplete

Whether the selected extraction contains the complete decision history. Default FALSE; incomplete evidence never excludes a contribution in date-window mode.

dActionExtractionDate

`Date` or ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` cutoff for frozen ActionLog extractions. `NULL` uses the results snapshot date, or `dActionAsOfDate` in date-window mode. The latest complete extraction on or before this cutoff is selected, without filling gaps from older extractions. Set an explicit date when replaying a scoring run whose ActionLog was frozen after the data snapshot. Signal snapshot dates do not establish when action states became known.

dActionAsOfDate

Optional Date or ISO date for action age in date-window mode. Defaults to the results snapshot, not today's date.

strMetricID

Metric ID assigned to the action-weighted score.

bScoreSnapshotNoAction

Apply snapshot-based No Action exclusions. Defaults to bUseSnapshotDate. FALSE retains displayed proxy dates without using them to exclude contributions.

Value

A list containing `Analysis_Summary` and `Analysis_ActionRiskScoreDetail`, retaining the maximum-weight denominator.
